question: Will at least one film surpass US$1 billion in worldwide box office before May 1, 2026?
summary: Ensemble probability is very high (96%), supported by historical 1B milestones and the 2025–early-2026 hits.
Objections raise plausible tail risks (outlier reliance, regulatory headwinds, crowded 2026 slate) but do not overturn the core signal.
Threshold analysis indicates the event is effectively certain within the target window, given prior 1B achievements and ongoing momentum.
Keep the ensemble as the calibrated center; acknowledge tail risks but avoid downward adjustment unless new systemic evidence emerges.
